sloka: भगीरथात् ककुत्स्थः च ककुत्स्थस्य रघुः तथा ।रघोः तु पुत्रः तेजस्वी प्रवृद्धः पुरुषादकः ॥१-७०-३९॥
transliteration: bhagīrathāt kakutsthaḥ ca kakutsthasya raghuḥ tathā ।raghoḥ tu putraḥ tejasvī pravṛddhaḥ puruṣādakaḥ ॥1-70-39॥

translations.english: Bhagiratha begot Kakustha whose son was Raghu. Powerful Pravriddha was Raghu's son. He became Purushadaka (cannibal), on the curse of Vasistha. He grasped water in order to retaliate Vasishta but was prevented by his wife. The water fell on his feet and he came to be known as Kalmashapada (feet polluted with water). Samkhana was born to him.
